core_obligations: Commutativity (proof lines 6774-6776): the commutativity of the first diagram is clear and implies the commutativity of the diagram of topoi once cocontinuity of the induced functor is known.

Cocontinuity (proof lines 6779-6792): given a covering in the localized target, cocontinuity of the original functor refines the images of a covering in the source site to it, and viewing the members as objects over the localizing object gives a covering of the localized source whose images refine the given covering.
proof_roadmap: Record the commutativity of the diagram of categories and reduce the diagram of topoi to cocontinuity.
Given a covering in the localized target, refine it using cocontinuity of the original functor.
View the members as objects of the localized source and conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a cocontinuous functor induces a cocontinuous functor between the localized sites, giving a commutative diagram of topoi (statement lines 6747-6771). The proof is a complete argument: the commutativity of the diagram of site functors is clear and the diagram of topoi follows once the induced functor is shown to be cocontinuous (proof lines 6774-6776); and cocontinuity is verified by taking a covering in the localized target, using cocontinuity of the original functor to produce a covering of the source whose images refine it, and viewing its members as objects over the localizing object (proof lines 6779-6792). The non-formal content is the refinement and the reinterpretation of the covering in the localized site. The claim is H2: a written-out verification with each input named.
